notes.title: Spring Falls featured in the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase
notes.notes:
The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CerebralPuzzleShowcase]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/url] launches today, featuring 100+ amazing puzzle games! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1040550/Spring_Falls/]Spring Falls[/url] will be 40% off until the end of the showcase at 10 AM PDT on May 24th, so if you've been holding off on picking up the game now would be a good time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34618189/7d66175baaa6ab0f4809ac9c25f1dc4258d53f48.png[/img]

The Cerebral Puzzle Showcase is a Steam event celebrating the entire puzzle game genre. It's been organized by [url=https://www.draknek.org/]Draknek and Friends[/url] and features titles such as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/736260/Baba_Is_You/]Baba is You[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1052990/A_Monsters_Expedition/]A Monster's Expedition[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/400/Portal/]Portal[/url], among so many others. There will be discounts as well as demos of unreleased titles! The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CerebralPuzzleShowcase]event page[/url] will be hosting streams of the featured games, so head over there to get a sampling of some unique brain-teasing games you may not have heard of.

Happy puzzling!

notes.title: Spring Falls makes me feel things that can only be conveyed through Jake Gyllenhaal gifs
notes.notes:
Spring Falls is a puzzle game that I’d absolutely love to have made. Everything it does has a purity and elegance that makes me think of Matthew Brown’s wonderful Hexcells games, from the soothing ambient guitar chords in the background to the pleasing geometry of the levels. But while Hexcells frequently made me feel like a genius, Spring Falls has only ever left me feeling… relaxed, but also vaguely bewildered and uncomprehending. Like I’ve emerged sleepily from my bed in the morning and headed downstairs to wash the dishes, only to find a chimp already at the sink calmly doing it all for me.

Coincidentally, this is the precise emotion that actor Jake Gyllenhaal is so gifted at conveying. So he’s gonna help me out every now and then in this post.

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: Whatever a furlong is
notes.notes:
There’s not long left before the big 20, but those crafty devs continue to release legions of games anyway, surely coveting the grand prize of a spot in the Unknown Pleasures annual finals. Or possibly they want to have enough money to buy food. Who can say?

Five more games join the ranks of the worthy today, for it is, once more, time for a selection of the finest under-appreciated games on Steam.

Doing that lungey thing sprinters do at the finish line this week: socialist revolution, cultist massacres, and pretty flowers.

notes.title: Spring Falls Releasing November 17th
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that Spring Falls will be coming to Steam on November 17th for PC, Mac, and Linux!

Watch the new trailer below:
[previewyoutube=Q0BZwPrU678;full][/previewyoutube]
After 2 years of development, it's so exciting to finally be getting this game out into the world and in the hands of players.

The release includes 60 hand-crafted levels of relaxing mountainside puzzles. We hope that the love and care that went into the game makes for a calming experience you can get lost in for a while.

Mark your calendar for the 17th and add Spring Falls to your wishlist today!
